notablePrerequisites: Gilded Lotus and Xenic Poltergeist does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Xenic Poltergeist by tapping it, targeting Gilded Lotus.
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Gilded Lotus.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any one color.
Activate Umbral Mantle by paying {3} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
